item.title: Psychoactive mushrooms in shamanism
item.description:
This article is for informational purposes only and is intended to provide historical, scientific, and cultural context. It does not encourage the use of drugs, psychoactive substances, or any other prohibited substances, nor does it promote their use. Any use of such substances may be dangerous to health and may violate the law. Please comply with the laws and take care of your health.

When we speak of shamanism, the first image that comes to many people’s minds is that of shamans using mushrooms or other “sacred plants” to enter a trance.
